AggExpr.description:
One aggregate over the measure's entity. ``count`` without a field counts rows. ``value`` aggregates a row
value instead of a field; ``percentile`` takes ``p`` (0-1, continuous, e.g. 0.85).
AggExpr.title: AggExpr

Arith.description:
Arithmetic over aggregates, e.g. variance = forecast - approved; ``div`` is NULL-safe on zero. A side may be
a plain number, e.g. go-lives in 12 months divided by 12.
Arith.title: Arith

kind.description: Knowledge kind, for the knowledge stage
kind.title: Kind

Band.description: One labelled range of a banded dimension: value > ``above`` and value <= ``upto`` (either side open).
Band.title: Band

Calc.description: Row arithmetic over fields, numbers and values; ``div`` is NULL on a zero divisor.
Calc.title: Calc

Calculator.description: One output of a record-level pack calculator (e.g. ``pmo_health_v1`` score or status).
Calculator.title: Calculator

ChartColours.description: A chart's colours (US-224): a scheme, and a swatch for any series or bar named by its label.
ChartColours.title: ChartColours

Check.description: Compare a row value with literals, e.g. days late > 60 or calculated health in (Red, Amber).
Check.title: Check

ColumnsIn.description: Entity key → source column names to add as fields.
ColumnsIn.title: ColumnsIn

ConnectionIn.description:
One form for every engine (SCR-09, connection form validation table; US-115). Required fields depend on
the engine; the descriptor keeps only non-secret settings (REQ-014).
ConnectionIn.title: ConnectionIn

DaysBetween.description:
Whole days from ``days_from`` to ``days_to`` (to - from); each side is a date field or the reporting date
shifted. Date-times count by their date. NULL when either date is blank.
DaysBetween.title: DaysBetween

Detail.description:
A detail table (US-158): the records of the measure's population, one row each, with these columns (fields
of the measure's entity), a default sort and the name its export uses.
Detail.title: Detail

DraftPatch.description: Replace whole sections of the draft (entities, links, measures, dimensions, settings).
DraftPatch.title: DraftPatch

FigureTone.description:
A figure's tone from a threshold (US-157): at or past ``warning`` it is a warning, at or past ``critical``
critical, otherwise good. ``higher_is_worse`` says which way "past" is (overdue projects: true).
FigureTone.title: FigureTone

FreshnessIn.description: Freshness model per connection (US-041; REQ-118; DEC-02).
FreshnessIn.title: FreshnessIn

GrantSummary.description: A permission given to this person on one connection (US-161), on top of their roles.
GrantSummary.title: GrantSummary

JumpIn.description: A host in front of the SSH server. ``id`` keeps a saved hop (its pinned key and password).
JumpIn.title: JumpIn

audience_role.description: Convenience: adds a second mapping row
audience_role.title: Audience Role

MeasureIn.description: What the Admin names the certified measure (Approve).
MeasureIn.title: MeasureIn

PackDimension.description:
A breakdown. ``field`` is the field it is about (catalogue, hiding, gaps). A computed dimension (US-156)
shows a row value instead: ``of`` alone for a text value (e.g. calculated health), ``of`` with ``bands`` for
labelled ranges of a number (e.g. days on hold). ``not_set`` labels blanks; ``other`` values outside every band.
PackDimension.title: Dimension

Predicate.description: One structured condition. Values are literals or a reference to a scope attribute.
Predicate.title: Predicate

Preferences.description: Interface preferences remembered per user (US-134). Unknown keys are refused.
Preferences.title: Preferences

ScopePolicyBulkIn.description: One condition (or all rows) for every pair of entity and role (US-172).
ScopePolicyBulkIn.title: ScopePolicyBulkIn

SectionsIn.description:
Manifest sections to replace, each as written in manifest.yaml (``pack_version``, ``title``, ``signature``,
``entities``, ``links``, ``measures``, ``dimensions``, ``calculators``, ``reports``, ``dashboards``,
``unavailable_reports``).
SectionsIn.title: SectionsIn

SshIn.description:
Reach the database through an SSH server, e.g. a bastion. On an edit, blank fields keep what is saved.
Key files and passwords go to the secrets store only and are never shown again.
SshIn.title: SshIn

reasons.description: A reason for each warning, by its id
reasons.title: Reasons

Today.description: Today's date shifted by ``offset_days`` (US-163), fixed once per run.
Today.title: Today
